Bolonga and Scotland midfielder Lewis Ferguson, 27, reveals he expects to play for Rangers one day. (National - subscription required, external)
Rangers winger Findlay Curtis is attracting loan interest from Scottish Premiership rivals and clubs in England as the 20-year-old struggles for a starting place in the lead-up to the January transfer window. (Football Insider, external)
Meanwhile, Rangers manager Derek McInnes is in the dark over the possibility of making 21-year-old Stuttgart winger Badredine Bouanani's loan move permanent. (Herald - subscription required, external)
Arsenal are plotting a move to sign 15-year-old Rangers right-back Kai Urban. (Football Insider, external)
